findings.why: this task has a catch-up doc, and a doc-bound task posts nothing per turn to Telegram (#424) -- so an ask that is not in this turn reaches no surface at all. Keep the ask in the journal (duplicate it into the doc, never move it): "**Needs from you:** ...", "Reply `word`", "**Next:** ..." or "**Your call:** ...". Use -DisableGuard G11 for a genuinely informational turn
